|lore=First floor: parasols and powdered blue milk. Second floor: bantha skin rugs, bog-wing drapes and juri juice tables. Third floor: a squadron of Imperial stormtroopers.
|joke=The lore is a department-store lift announcement, like the theme tune of the BBC sitcom ''Are You Being Served?'', in which a lift girl calls out each floor and its goods ("Second floor: carpets, travel goods and bedding…"). Here the goods are Star Wars ones, such as powdered [[Blue Milk|blue milk]] and [[Bantha]] skin rugs, and the third floor holds stormtroopers.<ref name="wp-aybs">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Are_You_Being_Served%3F Are You Being Served?], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250920155138/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Are_You_Being_Served%3F Internet Archive], 20 September 2025.</ref><ref name="hiwaay-aybs">[https://home.hiwaay.net/~emilyj/theme.html "Are You Being Served?": The Theme Song], Emily's AYBS pages. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20241008054122/https://home.hiwaay.net/~emilyj/theme.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2024.</ref> Department stores printed the same kind of floor-by-floor directory, such as Holden & Stone's "Store Directory" of 1907 ("First floor, front: Umbrellas, Ladies' Neckwear, Leather Goods").<ref name="hs1907">Holden & Stone advertisement, "Store Directory", ''Pittsfield Directory'' (1907), p. 555. [https://archive.org/details/pittsfield-ma-directory-collection Pittsfield + Berkshire County MA Directory Collection], Internet Archive, file Pittsfield_MA_Directory_1907. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/pittsfield-ma-directory-collection Internet Archive] (item pittsfield-ma-directory-collection).</ref> See [[Jokes#Lift Tube Escape|Jokes]].
|game_text=If opponent just initiated a battle, one of your Lift Tubes present may move as a 'react' from that battle. OR Place one of your unoccupied Lift Tubes on table in your Used Pile. OR Search your Reserve Deck, take one Lift Tube into hand and reshuffle.
